questions.q: In triangle $ABC$, the measure of angle $A$ is $48^\circ$ and the measure of angle $B$ is $72^\circ$. What is the measure of the exterior angle at vertex $C$?
questions.answer: The exterior angle theorem states that an exterior angle equals the sum of the two remote interior angles: $48^\circ + 72^\circ = 120^\circ$.

questions.q: What is the sum of the interior angle measures of a regular octagon (8-sided polygon)?
questions.answer: Sum of interior angles is $(n - 2) \times 180^\circ$. For $n = 8$: $(8 - 2) \times 180^\circ = 6 \times 180^\circ = 1,080^\circ$.

questions.q: Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. If one interior angle measures $(3x + 15)^\circ$ and its consecutive interior angle measures $(2x + 25)^\circ$, what is the value of $x$?
questions.answer: Consecutive interior angles are supplementary: $(3x + 15) + (2x + 25) = 180 \Rightarrow 5x + 40 = 180 \Rightarrow 5x = 140 \Rightarrow x = 28$.

sections.heading: Section 2: Right Triangle Trigonometry & Special Triangles

questions.q: In right triangle $ABC$ with right angle at $C$, $\sin A = \frac{5}{13}$. What is the value of $\cos B$?
questions.answer: In a right triangle, angles $A$ and $B$ are complementary ($A + B = 90^\circ$). By the cofunction identity, $\cos B = \sin A = \frac{5}{13}$.

questions.q: If $\sin(2x - 10^\circ) = \cos(3x + 20^\circ)$, where all angles are acute, what is the value of $x$?
A $30^\circ-60^\circ-90^\circ$ right triangle has a shorter leg of length $7$. What is the area of the triangle?
What is the radius of the circle with equation $x^2 + y^2 - 6x + 8y - 11 = 0$?
A circle in the $xy$-plane has center $(4, -2)$ and passes through the point $(7, 2)$. What is the equation of the circle?
questions.answer: Radius squared is distance squared: $r^2 = (7 - 4)^2 + (2 - (-2))^2 = 3^2 + 4^2 = 25$. Equation is $(x - 4)^2 + (y + 2)^2 = 25$.

questions.q: In a circle of radius $10$, a chord is drawn at a distance of $6$ units from the center. What is the length of the chord?
questions.answer: The perpendicular from the center bisects the chord. By Pythagorean theorem on the half-chord: $h^2 + 6^2 = 10^2 \Rightarrow h^2 = 64 \Rightarrow h = 8$. Full chord length is $2 \times 8 = 16$.

sections.heading: Section 4: Arc Lengths, Sector Areas & Volume

questions.q: A circle has a radius of $12$ cm. What is the length of an arc intercepted by a central angle of $\frac{2\pi}{3}$ radians?
questions.answer: Arc length formula is $s = r\theta = 12 \times \frac{2\pi}{3} = 8\pi$ cm.

questions.q: What is the area of a sector of a circle with radius $6$ cm and central angle $60^\circ$?
A right circular cylinder has a radius of $4$ cm and a height of $9$ cm. What is the volume of the cylinder?
questions.answer: Volume of cylinder: $V = \pi r^2 h = \pi (4^2)(9) = \pi(16)(9) = 144\pi \text{ cm}^3$.
